name: Subset Teaching Dimension of Private-Coordinate Cubes
proof: For every $n\ge1$, the private positive example $(p_v,1)$ teaches $h_v$ among the $2^n$ concepts. Thus every ordinary minimum teacher has size one, and its singleton sample belongs to only one target's initial minimum family. These families are already a subset-teaching fixed point, since their only proper subsample is empty and occurs for every target. There are at least two targets, so value zero is impossible.
